```{r}
# ===========================================================================
# Primordial CI Chondrite Mineralogy Reconstruction with Precise Densities
# ===========================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ===========================================
# 1. Define input parameters with precise densities
# ===========================================

# Current mineralogy from King et al. (2015)
current_minerals <- data.frame(
  mineral = c("Serpentine/saponite", "Magnetite", "Sulfides", "Carbonates", "Ferrihydrite"),
  vol_min = c(81, 6, 4, 0, 0),
  vol_max = c(84, 10, 7, 3, 4),
  vol_mean = c(83, 8, 5.5, 2, 1.5)
)

# Precise density values for endmember minerals
forsterite_density <- 3.271  # g/cm³
fayalite_density <- 4.390    # g/cm³
enstatite_density <- 3.200   # g/cm³
ferrosilite_density <- 3.960 # g/cm³
kamacite_density <- 7.900    # g/cm³ (α-Fe,Ni with ~5-7% Ni)
taenite_density <- 8.200     # g/cm³ (γ-Fe,Ni with higher Ni)
troilite_density <- 4.610    # g/cm³
pyrrhotite_density <- 4.580  # g/cm³
anorthite_density <- 2.760   # g/cm³
albite_density <- 2.620      # g/cm³
magnetite_density <- 5.175   # g/cm³
serpentine_density <- 2.550  # g/cm³ (adjusted for Fe content)
saponite_density <- 2.300    # g/cm³
dolomite_density <- 2.870    # g/cm³
ferrihydrite_density <- 3.800 # g/cm³
amorphous_density <- 2.200   # g/cm³

# Calculation of solid solution densities based on composition
# Olivine (Fo₉₀Fa₁₀)
olivine_fo_fraction <- 0.90
olivine_fa_fraction <- 0.10
olivine_density <- (olivine_fo_fraction * forsterite_density) + 
                   (olivine_fa_fraction * fayalite_density)

# Pyroxene (En₈₅Fs₁₅)
pyroxene_en_fraction <- 0.85
pyroxene_fs_fraction <- 0.15
pyroxene_density <- (pyroxene_en_fraction * enstatite_density) + 
                    (pyroxene_fs_fraction * ferrosilite_density)

# Plagioclase (An₈₀Ab₂₀)
plagioclase_an_fraction <- 0.80
plagioclase_ab_fraction <- 0.20
plagioclase_density <- (plagioclase_an_fraction * anorthite_density) + 
                       (plagioclase_ab_fraction * albite_density)

# Metal (93% Fe, 7% Ni)
metal_density <- kamacite_density  # Dominated by kamacite in primitive material

# Create updated density dataframe
densities <- data.frame(
  mineral = c("Serpentine", "Saponite", "Olivine", "Pyroxene", "Magnetite", 
              "Fe-Ni metal", "Troilite", "Pyrrhotite", "Plagioclase", 
              "Dolomite", "Ferrihydrite", "Amorphous silicate"),
  density_mean = c(serpentine_density, saponite_density, olivine_density, pyroxene_density, 
                  magnetite_density, metal_density, troilite_density, pyrrhotite_density, 
                  plagioclase_density, dolomite_density, ferrihydrite_density, amorphous_density),
  density_err = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 
                  0.10, 0.03, 0.05, 0.03, 
                  0.03, 0.10, 0.10)
)

cat("Calculated precise densities for mineral solid solutions:\n")
cat(sprintf("Olivine (Fo₉₀Fa₁₀): %.3f g/cm³\n", olivine_density))
cat(sprintf("Pyroxene (En₈₅Fs₁₅): %.3f g/cm³\n", pyroxene_density))
cat(sprintf("Plagioclase (An₈₀Ab₂₀): %.3f g/cm³\n", plagioclase_density))

# ===========================================
# 2. Define key relationships and parameters
# ===========================================

# Serpentine:Saponite ratio in phyllosilicates (Tomeoka & Buseck, 1988)
serp_ratio <- 0.7  # 70% serpentine
sap_ratio <- 0.3   # 30% saponite
serp_ratio_err <- 0.05  # uncertainty

# Volume expansion factors during hydration
vol_exp_ol_serp <- 1.35  # Olivine to serpentine expansion
vol_exp_ol_serp_err <- 0.05
vol_exp_px_sap <- 1.30   # Pyroxene to saponite expansion
vol_exp_px_sap_err <- 0.05

# Magnetite origin distribution based on multiple studies
mag_from_metal_ratio <- 0.35  # 35% from Fe,Ni metal oxidation
mag_from_sulfide_ratio <- 0.20  # 20% from sulfide oxidation
mag_from_serp_ratio <- 0.30  # 30% from serpentinization of Fe in olivine
mag_from_primary_ratio <- 0.15  # 15% primary nebular magnetite
mag_ratio_err <- 0.05  # uncertainty in these ratios

# Volume expansion during Fe-metal to magnetite conversion
metal_to_mag_exp <- 1.4  # 40% volume increase
metal_to_mag_exp_err <- 0.1

# Chemical composition parameters
# Weight fractions of elements in minerals
ca_in_dolomite <- 0.22  # Ca weight fraction in dolomite
al_in_saponite <- 0.09  # Al weight fraction in saponite
ca_in_anorthite <- 0.14  # Ca weight fraction in anorthite
al_in_anorthite <- 0.19  # Al weight fraction in anorthite
fe_in_olivine <- 0.15  # Fe weight fraction in olivine (Fa15 component)

# ===========================================
# 3. Custom simple error propagation functions
# ===========================================

# Function to get density for a mineral
get_density <- function(mineral_name) {
  density_row <- densities[densities$mineral == mineral_name, ]
  return(list(
    mean = density_row$density_mean,
    err = density_row$density_err
  ))
}

# Simple error propagation for multiplication: z = x * y
mult_error <- function(x, x_err, y, y_err) {
  z <- x * y
  z_err <- sqrt((x_err/x)^2 + (y_err/y)^2) * z
  return(list(mean = z, err = z_err))
}

# Simple error propagation for division: z = x / y
div_error <- function(x, x_err, y, y_err) {
  z <- x / y
  z_err <- sqrt((x_err/x)^2 + (y_err/y)^2) * z
  return(list(mean = z, err = z_err))
}

# Simple error propagation for addition: z = x + y
add_error <- function(x, x_err, y, y_err) {
  z <- x + y
  z_err <- sqrt(x_err^2 + y_err^2)
  return(list(mean = z, err = z_err))
}

# Simple error propagation for subtraction: z = x - y
sub_error <- function(x, x_err, y, y_err) {
  z <- x - y
  z_err <- sqrt(x_err^2 + y_err^2)
  return(list(mean = z, err = z_err))
}

# ===========================================
# 4. Perform the calculations
# ===========================================

# 4.1 Separate serpentine and saponite components
serp_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[1] * serp_ratio
serp_vol_err <- sqrt((current_minerals$vol_mean[1] * serp_ratio_err)^2 + 
                      (serp_ratio * (current_minerals$vol_max[1] - current_minerals$vol_min[1])/2)^2)

sap_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[1] * sap_ratio
sap_vol_err <- sqrt((current_minerals$vol_mean[1] * serp_ratio_err)^2 + 
                      (sap_ratio * (current_minerals$vol_max[1] - current_minerals$vol_min[1])/2)^2)

cat("\nPhyllosilicate components:\n")
cat(sprintf("Serpentine: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", serp_vol, serp_vol_err))
cat(sprintf("Saponite: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", sap_vol, sap_vol_err))

# 4.2 Calculate olivine from serpentine

# Get densities
d_serp <- get_density("Serpentine")
d_ol <- get_density("Olivine")

# Mass of serpentine
serp_mass_result <- mult_error(serp_vol, serp_vol_err, d_serp$mean, d_serp$err)
serp_mass <- serp_mass_result$mean
serp_mass_err <- serp_mass_result$err

# Convert mass to equivalent olivine mass
ol_mass_result <- mult_error(serp_mass, serp_mass_err, d_ol$mean/d_serp$mean, 
                            sqrt((d_ol$err/d_ol$mean)^2 + (d_serp$err/d_serp$mean)^2) * (d_ol$mean/d_serp$mean))
ol_mass <- ol_mass_result$mean
ol_mass_err <- ol_mass_result$err

# Convert to volume
ol_vol_result <- div_error(ol_mass, ol_mass_err, d_ol$mean, d_ol$err)
ol_vol <- ol_vol_result$mean
ol_vol_err <- ol_vol_result$err

# Apply volume correction for hydration expansion
ol_orig_vol_result <- div_error(ol_vol, ol_vol_err, vol_exp_ol_serp, vol_exp_ol_serp_err)
ol_orig_vol <- ol_orig_vol_result$mean
ol_orig_vol_err <- ol_orig_vol_result$err

# Account for magnetite from serpentinization
# Some Fe from olivine forms magnetite during serpentinization
# Adjust olivine volume to account for this Fe loss
# Rough calculation based on Fe in olivine that goes to magnetite
fe_to_mag_fraction <- 0.3  # ~30% of Fe in olivine forms magnetite
ol_adj_factor <- 1 + (olivine_fa_fraction * fe_to_mag_fraction)
ol_final_vol <- ol_orig_vol * ol_adj_factor
ol_final_vol_err <- ol_orig_vol_err * ol_adj_factor

cat("\nOlivine calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original olivine (accounting for Fe loss to magnetite): %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", 
            ol_final_vol, ol_final_vol_err))

# 4.3 Calculate pyroxene from saponite

# Get densities
d_sap <- get_density("Saponite")
d_px <- get_density("Pyroxene")

# Mass of saponite
sap_mass_result <- mult_error(sap_vol, sap_vol_err, d_sap$mean, d_sap$err)
sap_mass <- sap_mass_result$mean
sap_mass_err <- sap_mass_result$err

# Convert mass to equivalent pyroxene mass
px_mass_result <- mult_error(sap_mass, sap_mass_err, d_px$mean/d_sap$mean, 
                            sqrt((d_px$err/d_px$mean)^2 + (d_sap$err/d_sap$mean)^2) * (d_px$mean/d_sap$mean))
px_mass <- px_mass_result$mean
px_mass_err <- px_mass_result$err

# Convert to volume
px_vol_result <- div_error(px_mass, px_mass_err, d_px$mean, d_px$err)
px_vol <- px_vol_result$mean
px_vol_err <- px_vol_result$err

# Apply volume correction for hydration expansion
px_orig_vol_result <- div_error(px_vol, px_vol_err, vol_exp_px_sap, vol_exp_px_sap_err)
px_orig_vol <- px_orig_vol_result$mean
px_orig_vol_err <- px_orig_vol_result$err

cat("\nPyroxene calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original pyroxene: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", px_orig_vol, px_orig_vol_err))

# 4.4 Magnetite analysis
mag_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[2]
mag_vol_err <- (current_minerals$vol_max[2] - current_minerals$vol_min[2])/2

# Partition magnetite by origin
mag_from_metal_vol <- mag_vol * mag_from_metal_ratio
mag_from_metal_vol_err <- sqrt((mag_vol_err * mag_from_metal_ratio)^2 + (mag_vol * mag_ratio_err)^2)

mag_from_sulfide_vol <- mag_vol * mag_from_sulfide_ratio
mag_from_sulfide_vol_err <- sqrt((mag_vol_err * mag_from_sulfide_ratio)^2 + (mag_vol * mag_ratio_err)^2)

mag_from_serp_vol <- mag_vol * mag_from_serp_ratio
mag_from_serp_vol_err <- sqrt((mag_vol_err * mag_from_serp_ratio)^2 + (mag_vol * mag_ratio_err)^2)

mag_primary_vol <- mag_vol * mag_from_primary_ratio
mag_primary_vol_err <- sqrt((mag_vol_err * mag_from_primary_ratio)^2 + (mag_vol * mag_ratio_err)^2)

cat("\nMagnetite origins:\n")
cat(sprintf("From Fe-Ni metal: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", mag_from_metal_vol, mag_from_metal_vol_err))
cat(sprintf("From sulfides: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", mag_from_sulfide_vol, mag_from_sulfide_vol_err))
cat(sprintf("From serpentinization: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", mag_from_serp_vol, mag_from_serp_vol_err))
cat(sprintf("Primary nebular: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err))

# 4.5 Calculate Fe,Ni metal from magnetite
d_mag <- get_density("Magnetite")
d_metal <- get_density("Fe-Ni metal")

# Volume correction for metal oxidation to magnetite
metal_vol_from_mag_result <- div_error(mag_from_metal_vol, mag_from_metal_vol_err, metal_to_mag_exp, metal_to_mag_exp_err)
metal_vol_from_mag <- metal_vol_from_mag_result$mean
metal_vol_from_mag_err <- metal_vol_from_mag_result$err

# Density correction
metal_vol_orig_result <- mult_error(metal_vol_from_mag, metal_vol_from_mag_err, d_mag$mean/d_metal$mean, 
                                  sqrt((d_mag$err/d_mag$mean)^2 + (d_metal$err/d_metal$mean)^2) * (d_mag$mean/d_metal$mean))
metal_vol_orig <- metal_vol_orig_result$mean
metal_vol_orig_err <- metal_vol_orig_result$err

cat("\nFe,Ni metal calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original Fe,Ni metal: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", metal_vol_orig, metal_vol_orig_err))

# 4.6 Calculate original troilite from current sulfides and magnetite
d_troilite <- get_density("Troilite")
d_pyrrhotite <- get_density("Pyrrhotite")

sulfide_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[3]
sulfide_vol_err <- (current_minerals$vol_max[3] - current_minerals$vol_min[3])/2

# Current sulfides to troilite (accounting for Fe loss in pyrrhotite)
troilite_from_sulfide_result <- mult_error(sulfide_vol, sulfide_vol_err, d_pyrrhotite$mean/d_troilite$mean, 
                                         sqrt((d_pyrrhotite$err/d_pyrrhotite$mean)^2 + (d_troilite$err/d_troilite$mean)^2) * (d_pyrrhotite$mean/d_troilite$mean))
troilite_from_sulfide_vol <- troilite_from_sulfide_result$mean
troilite_from_sulfide_vol_err <- troilite_from_sulfide_result$err

# Troilite from magnetite (that formed from sulfide oxidation)
# Note: Factor 0.8 accounts for O addition and mass balance
mag_factor <- 0.8
troilite_from_mag_result <- mult_error(mag_from_sulfide_vol, mag_from_sulfide_vol_err, (d_mag$mean/d_troilite$mean) * mag_factor, 
                                     sqrt((d_mag$err/d_mag$mean)^2 + (d_troilite$err/d_troilite$mean)^2) * (d_mag$mean/d_troilite$mean) * mag_factor)
troilite_from_mag_vol <- troilite_from_mag_result$mean
troilite_from_mag_vol_err <- troilite_from_mag_result$err

# Total original troilite
troilite_orig_result <- add_error(troilite_from_sulfide_vol, troilite_from_sulfide_vol_err, troilite_from_mag_vol, troilite_from_mag_vol_err)
troilite_orig_vol <- troilite_orig_result$mean
troilite_orig_vol_err <- troilite_orig_result$err

cat("\nTroilite calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original troilite: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err))

# 4.7 Calculate plagioclase/anorthite
d_dolomite <- get_density("Dolomite")
d_anorthite <- get_density("Plagioclase")

carbonate_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[4]
carbonate_vol_err <- (current_minerals$vol_max[4] - current_minerals$vol_min[4])/2

# Ca contribution from carbonates
carbonate_ca_contrib_result <- mult_error(carbonate_vol, carbonate_vol_err, d_dolomite$mean * ca_in_dolomite, d_dolomite$err * ca_in_dolomite)
carbonate_ca_contrib <- carbonate_ca_contrib_result$mean
carbonate_ca_contrib_err <- carbonate_ca_contrib_result$err

# Al contribution from saponite
saponite_al_contrib_result <- mult_error(sap_vol, sap_vol_err, d_sap$mean * al_in_saponite, d_sap$err * al_in_saponite)
saponite_al_contrib <- saponite_al_contrib_result$mean
saponite_al_contrib_err <- saponite_al_contrib_result$err

# Convert to anorthite volume
anorthite_from_ca_result <- div_error(carbonate_ca_contrib, carbonate_ca_contrib_err, d_anorthite$mean * ca_in_anorthite, d_anorthite$err * ca_in_anorthite)
anorthite_from_ca_vol <- anorthite_from_ca_result$mean
anorthite_from_ca_vol_err <- anorthite_from_ca_result$err

anorthite_from_al_result <- div_error(saponite_al_contrib, saponite_al_contrib_err, d_anorthite$mean * al_in_anorthite, d_anorthite$err * al_in_anorthite)
anorthite_from_al_vol <- anorthite_from_al_result$mean
anorthite_from_al_vol_err <- anorthite_from_al_result$err

# Consider overlap (don't double-count)
anorthite_orig_vol <- max(anorthite_from_ca_vol, anorthite_from_al_vol)
anorthite_orig_vol_err <- ifelse(
  anorthite_from_ca_vol > anorthite_from_al_vol,
  anorthite_from_ca_vol_err,
  anorthite_from_al_vol_err
)

# Adjustment factor based on Al and Ca budgets
anorthite_correction <- 0.8  # Only ~80% of theoretical Al/Ca forms anorthite
anorthite_final_vol <- anorthite_orig_vol * anorthite_correction
anorthite_final_vol_err <- anorthite_orig_vol_err * anorthite_correction

cat("\nPlagioclase/anorthite calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original plagioclase: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err))

# 4.8 Calculate amorphous silicate component
d_amorphous <- get_density("Amorphous silicate")

# Sum of all crystalline components
crystalline_sum_result <- add_error(
  ol_final_vol, ol_final_vol_err,
  add_error(
    px_orig_vol, px_orig_vol_err,
    add_error(
      metal_vol_orig, metal_vol_orig_err,
      add_error(
        troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err,
        add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$mean, add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$err
      )$mean, add_error(
        troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err,
        add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$mean, add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$err
      )$err
    )$mean, add_error(
      metal_vol_orig, metal_vol_orig_err,
      add_error(
        troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err,
        add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$mean, add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$err
      )$mean, add_error(
        troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err,
        add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$mean, add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$err
      )$err
    )$err
  )$mean, add_error(
    px_orig_vol, px_orig_vol_err,
    add_error(
      metal_vol_orig, metal_vol_orig_err,
      add_error(
        troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err,
        add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$mean, add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$err
      )$mean, add_error(
        troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err,
        add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$mean, add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$err
      )$err
    )$mean, add_error(
      metal_vol_orig, metal_vol_orig_err,
      add_error(
        troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err,
        add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$mean, add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$err
      )$mean, add_error(
        troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err,
        add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$mean, add_error(
          anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err,
          mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err
        )$err
      )$err
    )$err
  )$err
)

crystalline_sum <- crystalline_sum_result$mean
crystalline_sum_err <- crystalline_sum_result$err

# Alternative simpler calculation for crystalline sum (use this if the nested approach is too complex)
crystalline_sum_simple <- ol_final_vol + px_orig_vol + metal_vol_orig + troilite_orig_vol + anorthite_final_vol + mag_primary_vol
crystalline_sum_err_simple <- sqrt(ol_final_vol_err^2 + px_orig_vol_err^2 + metal_vol_orig_err^2 + 
                                 troilite_orig_vol_err^2 + anorthite_final_vol_err^2 + mag_primary_vol_err^2)

# Use the simpler approach for clarity
crystalline_sum <- crystalline_sum_simple
crystalline_sum_err <- crystalline_sum_err_simple

# Calculate remaining volume
amorphous_vol <- 100 - crystalline_sum
amorphous_vol_err <- crystalline_sum_err

cat("\nAmorphous silicate calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Amorphous silicate: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", amorphous_vol, amorphous_vol_err))

# ===========================================
# 5. Calculate endmember components by weight and mole
# ===========================================

# 5.1 Olivine endmember calculation
# Convert volume to mass
ol_mass <- ol_final_vol * d_ol$mean
ol_fo_mass <- ol_mass * olivine_fo_fraction * (forsterite_density/olivine_density)
ol_fa_mass <- ol_mass * olivine_fa_fraction * (fayalite_density/olivine_density)

# Calculate molar amounts (simplified)
mol_mass_fo <- 140.69  # g/mol for Mg₂SiO₄
mol_mass_fa <- 203.78  # g/mol for Fe₂SiO₄
ol_fo_moles <- ol_fo_mass / mol_mass_fo
ol_fa_moles <- ol_fa_mass / mol_mass_fa
ol_total_moles <- ol_fo_moles + ol_fa_moles

# Molar percentages
ol_fo_mol_percent <- ol_fo_moles / ol_total_moles * 100
ol_fa_mol_percent <- ol_fa_moles / ol_total_moles * 100

# 5.2 Pyroxene endmember calculation
# Convert volume to mass
px_mass <- px_orig_vol * d_px$mean
px_en_mass <- px_mass * pyroxene_en_fraction * (enstatite_density/pyroxene_density)
px_fs_mass <- px_mass * pyroxene_fs_fraction * (ferrosilite_density/pyroxene_density)

# Calculate molar amounts
mol_mass_en <- 100.39  # g/mol for MgSiO₃
mol_mass_fs <- 131.93  # g/mol for FeSiO₃
px_en_moles <- px_en_mass / mol_mass_en
px_fs_moles <- px_fs_mass / mol_mass_fs
px_total_moles <- px_en_moles + px_fs_moles

# Molar percentages
px_en_mol_percent <- px_en_moles / px_total_moles * 100
px_fs_mol_percent <- px_fs_moles / px_total_moles * 100

# 5.3 Plagioclase endmember calculation
# Convert volume to mass
pl_mass <- anorthite_final_vol * d_anorthite$mean
pl_an_mass <- pl_mass * plagioclase_an_fraction * (anorthite_density/plagioclase_density)
pl_ab_mass <- pl_mass * plagioclase_ab_fraction * (albite_density/plagioclase_density)

# Calculate molar amounts
mol_mass_an <- 278.21  # g/mol for CaAl₂Si₂O₈
mol_mass_ab <- 262.22  # g/mol for NaAlSi₃O₈
pl_an_moles <- pl_an_mass / mol_mass_an
pl_ab_moles <- pl_ab_mass / mol_mass_ab
pl_total_moles <- pl_an_moles + pl_ab_moles

# Molar percentages
pl_an_mol_percent <- pl_an_moles / pl_total_moles * 100
pl_ab_mol_percent <- pl_ab_moles / pl_total_moles * 100

# 5.4 Fe,Ni metal composition (weight percentages)
metal_fe_wt_percent <- 93.0  # Typical for primitive Fe,Ni metal
metal_ni_wt_percent <- 7.0

# 5.5 Amorphous silicate composition (approximate molar ratios)
amorphous_mgsi_ratio <- 1.1  # Mg/Si
amorphous_fesi_ratio <- 0.4  # Fe/Si
amorphous_alsi_ratio <- 0.08 # Al/Si
amorphous_casi_ratio <- 0.06 # Ca/Si
amorphous_nasi_ratio <- 0.05 # Na/Si

# ===========================================
# 6. Generate final results table with endmember breakdown
# ===========================================

# Create summary table with endmember compositions
primordial_mineralogy <- data.frame(
  mineral = c("Olivine", "Low-Ca Pyroxene", "Fe,Ni metal", 
              "Troilite", "Plagioclase", "Primary magnetite", "Amorphous silicate"),
  vol_percent = c(ol_final_vol, px_orig_vol, metal_vol_orig, 
                 troilite_orig_vol, anorthite_final_vol, mag_primary_vol, amorphous_vol),
  vol_error = c(ol_final_vol_err, px_orig_vol_err, metal_vol_orig_err, 
               troilite_orig_vol_err, anorthite_final_vol_err, mag_primary_vol_err, amorphous_vol_err),
  vol_range = c(
    paste(round(ol_final_vol - ol_final_vol_err), "-", round(ol_final_vol + ol_final_vol_err)),
    paste(round(px_orig_vol - px_orig_vol_err), "-", round(px_orig_vol + px_orig_vol_err)),
    paste(round(metal_vol_orig - metal_vol_orig_err), "-", round(metal_vol_orig + metal_vol_orig_err)),
    paste(round(troilite_orig_vol - troilite_orig_vol_err), "-", round(troilite_orig_vol + troilite_orig_vol_err)),
    paste(round(anorthite_final_vol - anorthite_final_vol_err), "-", round(anorthite_final_vol + anorthite_final_vol_err)),
    paste(round(mag_primary_vol - mag_primary_vol_err), "-", round(mag_primary_vol + mag_primary_vol_err)),
    paste(round(amorphous_vol - amorphous_vol_err), "-", round(amorphous_vol + amorphous_vol_err))
  ),
  density = c(olivine_density, pyroxene_density, metal_density, 
             troilite_density, plagioclase_density, magnetite_density, amorphous_density),
  composition = c(
    sprintf("Fo₉₀Fa₁₀ (%.1f mol%% Mg₂SiO₄, %.1f mol%% Fe₂SiO₄)", ol_fo_mol_percent, ol_fa_mol_percent),
    sprintf("En₈₅Fs₁₅ (%.1f mol%% MgSiO₃, %.1f mol%% FeSiO₃)", px_en_mol_percent, px_fs_mol_percent),
    sprintf("Fe₉₃Ni₇ (%.1f wt%% Fe, %.1f wt%% Ni)", metal_fe_wt_percent, metal_ni_wt_percent),
    "FeS (pure)",
    sprintf("An₈₀Ab₂₀ (%.1f mol%% CaAl₂Si₂O₈, %.1f mol%% NaAlSi₃O₈)", pl_an_mol_percent, pl_ab_mol_percent),
    "Fe₃O₄ (pure)",
    sprintf("GEMS-like (Mg/Si=%.1f, Fe/Si=%.1f, Al/Si=%.2f)", amorphous_mgsi_ratio, amorphous_fesi_ratio, amorphous_alsi_ratio)
  )
)

# Calculate mass percentages
primordial_mineralogy$mass_percent <- primordial_mineralogy$vol_percent * primordial_mineralogy$density
primordial_mineralogy$mass_percent <- primordial_mineralogy$mass_percent / sum(primordial_mineralogy$mass_percent) * 100

# Print final table
cat("\n========== RECONSTRUCTED PRIMORDIAL CI CHONDRITE MINERALOGY ==========\n")
print(primordial_mineralogy[, c("mineral", "vol_percent", "vol_error", "vol_range", "mass_percent", "density", "composition")])
cat("=====================================================================\n")

# ===========================================
# 7. Generate detailed endmember breakdown table
# ===========================================

# Create detailed endmember breakdown
endmember_breakdown <- data.frame(
  component = c(
    "Forsterite (Mg₂SiO₄)", 
    "Fayalite (Fe₂SiO₄)", 
    "Enstatite (MgSiO₃)", 
    "Ferrosilite (FeSiO₃)", 
    "Kamacite (Fe,Ni metal)", 
    "Troilite (FeS)", 
    "Anorthite (CaAl₂Si₂O₈)", 
    "Albite (NaAlSi₃O₈)", 
    "Primary Magnetite (Fe₃O₄)",
    "Amorphous silicate"
  ),
  vol_percent = c(
    ol_final_vol * olivine_fo_fraction, 
    ol_final_vol * olivine_fa_fraction,
    px_orig_vol * pyroxene_en_fraction,
    px_orig_vol * pyroxene_fs_fraction,
    metal_vol_orig,
    troilite_orig_vol,
    anorthite_final_vol * plagioclase_an_fraction,
    anorthite_final_vol * plagioclase_ab_fraction,
    mag_primary_vol,
    amorphous_vol
  ),
  density = c(
    forsterite_density,
    fayalite_density,
    enstatite_density,
    ferrosilite_density,
    kamacite_density,
    troilite_density,
    anorthite_density,
    albite_density,
    magnetite_density,
    amorphous_density
  ),
  formula = c(
    "Mg₂SiO₄",
    "Fe₂SiO₄",
    "MgSiO₃",
    "FeSiO₃",
    "Fe₉₃Ni₇",
    "FeS",
    "CaAl₂Si₂O₈",
    "NaAlSi₃O₈",
    "Fe₃O₄",
    "Variable (GEMS-like)"
  )
)

# Calculate mass percentages for each endmember
endmember_breakdown$mass <- endmember_breakdown$vol_percent * endmember_breakdown$density
endmember_breakdown$mass_percent <- endmember_breakdown$mass / sum(endmember_breakdown$mass) * 100

cat("\n========== DETAILED ENDMEMBER BREAKDOWN ==========\n")
print(endmember_breakdown[, c("component", "vol_percent", "mass_percent", "density", "formula")])
cat("====================================================\n")

# ===========================================
# 8. Visualize results
# ===========================================

# Create bar plot with error bars
ggplot(primordial_mineralogy, aes(x = reorder(mineral, vol_percent), y = vol_percent)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = vol_percent - vol_error, ymax = vol_percent + vol_error), width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Reconstructed Primordial CI Chondrite Mineralogy",
    subtitle = "Volume percentages with uncertainties",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Volume %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Create pie chart of endmember components
endmember_breakdown$component <- factor(endmember_breakdown$component, 
                                      levels = endmember_breakdown$component[order(endmember_breakdown$mass_percent, decreasing = TRUE)])

ggplot(endmember_breakdown, aes(x = "", y = mass_percent, fill = component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Primordial CI Chondrite Mineral Endmember Distribution",
    subtitle = "Mass percentages",
    fill = "Mineral Component"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```


```{r}
# ===========================================================================
# Primordial CI Chondrite Mineralogy Reconstruction with Phosphorus
# ===========================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ===========================================
# 1. Define input parameters with precise densities
# ===========================================

# Current mineralogy from King et al. (2015)
current_minerals <- data.frame(
  mineral = c("Serpentine/saponite", "Magnetite", "Sulfides", "Carbonates", "Ferrihydrite"),
  vol_min = c(81, 6, 4, 0, 0),
  vol_max = c(84, 10, 7, 3, 4),
  vol_mean = c(83, 8, 5.5, 2, 1.5)
)

# Phosphorus content from Alexander (2019)
bulk_p_content_wt_percent <- 0.145  # wt% P in CI chondrites
bulk_p_content_ppm <- 1450  # ppm P (equivalent)

# Precise density values for endmember minerals
forsterite_density <- 3.271  # g/cm³
fayalite_density <- 4.390    # g/cm³
enstatite_density <- 3.200   # g/cm³
ferrosilite_density <- 3.960 # g/cm³
kamacite_density <- 7.900    # g/cm³ (α-Fe,Ni with ~5-7% Ni)
taenite_density <- 8.200     # g/cm³ (γ-Fe,Ni with higher Ni)
troilite_density <- 4.610    # g/cm³
pyrrhotite_density <- 4.580  # g/cm³
anorthite_density <- 2.760   # g/cm³
albite_density <- 2.620      # g/cm³
magnetite_density <- 5.175   # g/cm³
serpentine_density <- 2.550  # g/cm³ (adjusted for Fe content)
saponite_density <- 2.300    # g/cm³
dolomite_density <- 2.870    # g/cm³
ferrihydrite_density <- 3.800 # g/cm³
amorphous_density <- 2.200   # g/cm³

# Phosphorus-bearing minerals
schreibersite_density <- 7.100  # g/cm³ for (Fe,Ni)₃P
apatite_density <- 3.200        # g/cm³ for Ca₅(PO₄)₃(OH,F,Cl)
whitlockite_density <- 3.120    # g/cm³ for Ca₃(PO₄)₂

# Phosphorus content in phosphorus-bearing minerals
p_in_schreibersite <- 0.154  # 15.4 wt% P in (Fe,Ni)₃P
p_in_apatite <- 0.185        # ~18.5 wt% P in apatite
p_in_whitlockite <- 0.200    # ~20.0 wt% P in whitlockite

cat("Phosphorus budget calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Bulk P content in CI chondrites: %.3f wt%% (%.0f ppm)\n", bulk_p_content_wt_percent, bulk_p_content_ppm))

# Calculation of solid solution densities based on composition
# Olivine (Fo₉₀Fa₁₀)
olivine_fo_fraction <- 0.90
olivine_fa_fraction <- 0.10
olivine_density <- (olivine_fo_fraction * forsterite_density) + 
                   (olivine_fa_fraction * fayalite_density)

# Pyroxene (En₈₅Fs₁₅)
pyroxene_en_fraction <- 0.85
pyroxene_fs_fraction <- 0.15
pyroxene_density <- (pyroxene_en_fraction * enstatite_density) + 
                    (pyroxene_fs_fraction * ferrosilite_density)

# Plagioclase (An₈₀Ab₂₀)
plagioclase_an_fraction <- 0.80
plagioclase_ab_fraction <- 0.20
plagioclase_density <- (plagioclase_an_fraction * anorthite_density) + 
                       (plagioclase_ab_fraction * albite_density)

# Metal (93% Fe, 7% Ni)
metal_density <- kamacite_density  # Dominated by kamacite in primitive material

# Create updated density dataframe including P-bearing minerals
densities <- data.frame(
  mineral = c("Serpentine", "Saponite", "Olivine", "Pyroxene", "Magnetite", 
              "Fe-Ni metal", "Troilite", "Pyrrhotite", "Plagioclase", 
              "Dolomite", "Ferrihydrite", "Amorphous silicate", 
              "Schreibersite", "Apatite", "Whitlockite"),
  density_mean = c(serpentine_density, saponite_density, olivine_density, pyroxene_density, 
                  magnetite_density, metal_density, troilite_density, pyrrhotite_density, 
                  plagioclase_density, dolomite_density, ferrihydrite_density, amorphous_density,
                  schreibersite_density, apatite_density, whitlockite_density),
  density_err = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 
                  0.10, 0.03, 0.05, 0.03, 
                  0.03, 0.10, 0.10,
                  0.10, 0.05, 0.05)
)

cat("Calculated precise densities for mineral solid solutions:\n")
cat(sprintf("Olivine (Fo₉₀Fa₁₀): %.3f g/cm³\n", olivine_density))
cat(sprintf("Pyroxene (En₈₅Fs₁₅): %.3f g/cm³\n", pyroxene_density))
cat(sprintf("Plagioclase (An₈₀Ab₂₀): %.3f g/cm³\n", plagioclase_density))

# ===========================================
# 2. Define key relationships and parameters
# ===========================================

# Serpentine:Saponite ratio in phyllosilicates (Tomeoka & Buseck, 1988)
serp_ratio <- 0.7  # 70% serpentine
sap_ratio <- 0.3   # 30% saponite
serp_ratio_err <- 0.05  # uncertainty

# Volume expansion factors during hydration
vol_exp_ol_serp <- 1.35  # Olivine to serpentine expansion
vol_exp_ol_serp_err <- 0.05
vol_exp_px_sap <- 1.30   # Pyroxene to saponite expansion
vol_exp_px_sap_err <- 0.05

# Magnetite origin distribution based on multiple studies
mag_from_metal_ratio <- 0.35  # 35% from Fe,Ni metal oxidation
mag_from_sulfide_ratio <- 0.20  # 20% from sulfide oxidation
mag_from_serp_ratio <- 0.30  # 30% from serpentinization of Fe in olivine
mag_from_primary_ratio <- 0.15  # 15% primary nebular magnetite
mag_ratio_err <- 0.05  # uncertainty in these ratios

# Volume expansion during Fe-metal to magnetite conversion
metal_to_mag_exp <- 1.4  # 40% volume increase
metal_to_mag_exp_err <- 0.1

# Phosphorus distribution in primordial material
# Based on studies of primitive chondrites, P is primarily in schreibersite
p_in_schreibersite_fraction <- 0.85  # 85% of P in schreibersite
p_in_phosphates_fraction <- 0.15     # 15% of P in phosphate minerals (mainly apatite)
p_fraction_err <- 0.05

# Chemical composition parameters
# Weight fractions of elements in minerals
ca_in_dolomite <- 0.22  # Ca weight fraction in dolomite
al_in_saponite <- 0.09  # Al weight fraction in saponite
ca_in_anorthite <- 0.14  # Ca weight fraction in anorthite
al_in_anorthite <- 0.19  # Al weight fraction in anorthite
fe_in_olivine <- 0.15  # Fe weight fraction in olivine (Fa15 component)

# ===========================================
# 3. Custom simple error propagation functions
# ===========================================

# Function to get density for a mineral
get_density <- function(mineral_name) {
  density_row <- densities[densities$mineral == mineral_name, ]
  return(list(
    mean = density_row$density_mean,
    err = density_row$density_err
  ))
}

# Simple error propagation functions
mult_error <- function(x, x_err, y, y_err) {
  z <- x * y
  z_err <- sqrt((x_err/x)^2 + (y_err/y)^2) * z
  return(list(mean = z, err = z_err))
}

div_error <- function(x, x_err, y, y_err) {
  z <- x / y
  z_err <- sqrt((x_err/x)^2 + (y_err/y)^2) * z
  return(list(mean = z, err = z_err))
}

add_error <- function(x, x_err, y, y_err) {
  z <- x + y
  z_err <- sqrt(x_err^2 + y_err^2)
  return(list(mean = z, err = z_err))
}

sub_error <- function(x, x_err, y, y_err) {
  z <- x - y
  z_err <- sqrt(x_err^2 + y_err^2)
  return(list(mean = z, err = z_err))
}

# ===========================================
# 4. Calculate phosphorus-bearing minerals first
# ===========================================

# 4.1 Calculate schreibersite abundance
# Mass of schreibersite needed to account for bulk P (assuming 85% of P is in schreibersite)
p_in_schreibersite_total <- bulk_p_content_wt_percent * p_in_schreibersite_fraction
schreibersite_mass_percent <- p_in_schreibersite_total / p_in_schreibersite
schreibersite_mass_percent_err <- schreibersite_mass_percent * sqrt((p_fraction_err/p_in_schreibersite_fraction)^2 + 0.01) # small additional uncertainty

# Convert mass percent to volume percent
# Assume average density of CI chondrite material ~2.2 g/cm³ (close to current CI bulk density)
average_ci_density <- 2.2
schreibersite_vol_percent <- schreibersite_mass_percent * (average_ci_density / schreibersite_density)
schreibersite_vol_percent_err <- schreibersite_mass_percent_err * (average_ci_density / schreibersite_density)

cat("\nPhosphorus mineralogy calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("P in schreibersite: %.3f wt%% (%.1f%% of total P)\n", p_in_schreibersite_total, p_in_schreibersite_fraction*100))
cat(sprintf("Schreibersite abundance: %.3f wt%% (%.3f vol%%)\n", schreibersite_mass_percent, schreibersite_vol_percent))

# 4.2 Calculate phosphate mineral abundance
# Remaining P goes to phosphate minerals (primarily apatite in primitive materials)
p_in_phosphates_total <- bulk_p_content_wt_percent * p_in_phosphates_fraction
apatite_mass_percent <- p_in_phosphates_total / p_in_apatite
apatite_mass_percent_err <- apatite_mass_percent * sqrt((p_fraction_err/p_in_phosphates_fraction)^2 + 0.01)

# Convert to volume percent
apatite_vol_percent <- apatite_mass_percent * (average_ci_density / apatite_density)
apatite_vol_percent_err <- apatite_mass_percent_err * (average_ci_density / apatite_density)

cat(sprintf("P in phosphates: %.3f wt%% (%.1f%% of total P)\n", p_in_phosphates_total, p_in_phosphates_fraction*100))
cat(sprintf("Apatite abundance: %.3f wt%% (%.3f vol%%)\n", apatite_mass_percent, apatite_vol_percent))

# ===========================================
# 5. Perform the main mineral calculations (adjusted for P minerals)
# ===========================================

# 5.1 Separate serpentine and saponite components
serp_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[1] * serp_ratio
serp_vol_err <- sqrt((current_minerals$vol_mean[1] * serp_ratio_err)^2 + 
                      (serp_ratio * (current_minerals$vol_max[1] - current_minerals$vol_min[1])/2)^2)

sap_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[1] * sap_ratio
sap_vol_err <- sqrt((current_minerals$vol_mean[1] * serp_ratio_err)^2 + 
                      (sap_ratio * (current_minerals$vol_max[1] - current_minerals$vol_min[1])/2)^2)

cat("\nPhyllosilicate components:\n")
cat(sprintf("Serpentine: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", serp_vol, serp_vol_err))
cat(sprintf("Saponite: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", sap_vol, sap_vol_err))

# 5.2 Calculate olivine from serpentine
d_serp <- get_density("Serpentine")
d_ol <- get_density("Olivine")

serp_mass_result <- mult_error(serp_vol, serp_vol_err, d_serp$mean, d_serp$err)
ol_mass_result <- mult_error(serp_mass_result$mean, serp_mass_result$err, d_ol$mean/d_serp$mean, 
                            sqrt((d_ol$err/d_ol$mean)^2 + (d_serp$err/d_serp$mean)^2) * (d_ol$mean/d_serp$mean))
ol_vol_result <- div_error(ol_mass_result$mean, ol_mass_result$err, d_ol$mean, d_ol$err)
ol_orig_vol_result <- div_error(ol_vol_result$mean, ol_vol_result$err, vol_exp_ol_serp, vol_exp_ol_serp_err)

# Account for magnetite from serpentinization
fe_to_mag_fraction <- 0.3
ol_adj_factor <- 1 + (olivine_fa_fraction * fe_to_mag_fraction)
ol_final_vol <- ol_orig_vol_result$mean * ol_adj_factor
ol_final_vol_err <- ol_orig_vol_result$err * ol_adj_factor

cat("\nOlivine calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original olivine (accounting for Fe loss to magnetite): %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", 
            ol_final_vol, ol_final_vol_err))

# 5.3 Calculate pyroxene from saponite
d_sap <- get_density("Saponite")
d_px <- get_density("Pyroxene")

sap_mass_result <- mult_error(sap_vol, sap_vol_err, d_sap$mean, d_sap$err)
px_mass_result <- mult_error(sap_mass_result$mean, sap_mass_result$err, d_px$mean/d_sap$mean, 
                            sqrt((d_px$err/d_px$mean)^2 + (d_sap$err/d_sap$mean)^2) * (d_px$mean/d_sap$mean))
px_vol_result <- div_error(px_mass_result$mean, px_mass_result$err, d_px$mean, d_px$err)
px_orig_vol_result <- div_error(px_vol_result$mean, px_vol_result$err, vol_exp_px_sap, vol_exp_px_sap_err)

px_orig_vol <- px_orig_vol_result$mean
px_orig_vol_err <- px_orig_vol_result$err

cat("\nPyroxene calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original pyroxene: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", px_orig_vol, px_orig_vol_err))

# 5.4 Magnetite analysis
mag_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[2]
mag_vol_err <- (current_minerals$vol_max[2] - current_minerals$vol_min[2])/2

mag_from_metal_vol <- mag_vol * mag_from_metal_ratio
mag_from_metal_vol_err <- sqrt((mag_vol_err * mag_from_metal_ratio)^2 + (mag_vol * mag_ratio_err)^2)

mag_from_sulfide_vol <- mag_vol * mag_from_sulfide_ratio
mag_from_sulfide_vol_err <- sqrt((mag_vol_err * mag_from_sulfide_ratio)^2 + (mag_vol * mag_ratio_err)^2)

mag_from_serp_vol <- mag_vol * mag_from_serp_ratio
mag_from_serp_vol_err <- sqrt((mag_vol_err * mag_from_serp_ratio)^2 + (mag_vol * mag_ratio_err)^2)

mag_primary_vol <- mag_vol * mag_from_primary_ratio
mag_primary_vol_err <- sqrt((mag_vol_err * mag_from_primary_ratio)^2 + (mag_vol * mag_ratio_err)^2)

cat("\nMagnetite origins:\n")
cat(sprintf("From Fe-Ni metal: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", mag_from_metal_vol, mag_from_metal_vol_err))
cat(sprintf("From sulfides: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", mag_from_sulfide_vol, mag_from_sulfide_vol_err))
cat(sprintf("From serpentinization: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", mag_from_serp_vol, mag_from_serp_vol_err))
cat(sprintf("Primary nebular: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", mag_primary_vol, mag_primary_vol_err))

# 5.5 Calculate Fe,Ni metal from magnetite (adjusted for schreibersite)
d_mag <- get_density("Magnetite")
d_metal <- get_density("Fe-Ni metal")

metal_vol_from_mag_result <- div_error(mag_from_metal_vol, mag_from_metal_vol_err, metal_to_mag_exp, metal_to_mag_exp_err)
metal_vol_orig_result <- mult_error(metal_vol_from_mag_result$mean, metal_vol_from_mag_result$err, d_mag$mean/d_metal$mean, 
                                  sqrt((d_mag$err/d_mag$mean)^2 + (d_metal$err/d_metal$mean)^2) * (d_mag$mean/d_metal$mean))

# Add volume for schreibersite (which would have been associated with metal)
# Schreibersite is typically found as inclusions in or associated with Fe,Ni metal
total_metal_schreibersite_vol <- metal_vol_orig_result$mean + schreibersite_vol_percent
total_metal_schreibersite_vol_err <- sqrt(metal_vol_orig_result$err^2 + schreibersite_vol_percent_err^2)

metal_vol_orig <- metal_vol_orig_result$mean
metal_vol_orig_err <- metal_vol_orig_result$err

cat("\nFe,Ni metal and schreibersite calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original Fe,Ni metal: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", metal_vol_orig, metal_vol_orig_err))
cat(sprintf("Schreibersite: %.3f ± %.3f vol%%\n", schreibersite_vol_percent, schreibersite_vol_percent_err))
cat(sprintf("Total metal+schreibersite: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", total_metal_schreibersite_vol, total_metal_schreibersite_vol_err))

# 5.6 Calculate original troilite
d_troilite <- get_density("Troilite")
d_pyrrhotite <- get_density("Pyrrhotite")

sulfide_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[3]
sulfide_vol_err <- (current_minerals$vol_max[3] - current_minerals$vol_min[3])/2

troilite_from_sulfide_result <- mult_error(sulfide_vol, sulfide_vol_err, d_pyrrhotite$mean/d_troilite$mean, 
                                         sqrt((d_pyrrhotite$err/d_pyrrhotite$mean)^2 + (d_troilite$err/d_troilite$mean)^2) * (d_pyrrhotite$mean/d_troilite$mean))

mag_factor <- 0.8
troilite_from_mag_result <- mult_error(mag_from_sulfide_vol, mag_from_sulfide_vol_err, (d_mag$mean/d_troilite$mean) * mag_factor, 
                                     sqrt((d_mag$err/d_mag$mean)^2 + (d_troilite$err/d_troilite$mean)^2) * (d_mag$mean/d_troilite$mean) * mag_factor)

troilite_orig_result <- add_error(troilite_from_sulfide_result$mean, troilite_from_sulfide_result$err, 
                                 troilite_from_mag_result$mean, troilite_from_mag_result$err)
troilite_orig_vol <- troilite_orig_result$mean
troilite_orig_vol_err <- troilite_orig_result$err

cat("\nTroilite calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original troilite: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", troilite_orig_vol, troilite_orig_vol_err))

# 5.7 Calculate plagioclase/anorthite
d_dolomite <- get_density("Dolomite")
d_anorthite <- get_density("Plagioclase")

carbonate_vol <- current_minerals$vol_mean[4]
carbonate_vol_err <- (current_minerals$vol_max[4] - current_minerals$vol_min[4])/2

carbonate_ca_contrib_result <- mult_error(carbonate_vol, carbonate_vol_err, d_dolomite$mean * ca_in_dolomite, d_dolomite$err * ca_in_dolomite)
saponite_al_contrib_result <- mult_error(sap_vol, sap_vol_err, d_sap$mean * al_in_saponite, d_sap$err * al_in_saponite)

anorthite_from_ca_result <- div_error(carbonate_ca_contrib_result$mean, carbonate_ca_contrib_result$err, d_anorthite$mean * ca_in_anorthite, d_anorthite$err * ca_in_anorthite)
anorthite_from_al_result <- div_error(saponite_al_contrib_result$mean, saponite_al_contrib_result$err, d_anorthite$mean * al_in_anorthite, d_anorthite$err * al_in_anorthite)

anorthite_orig_vol <- max(anorthite_from_ca_result$mean, anorthite_from_al_result$mean)
anorthite_orig_vol_err <- ifelse(
  anorthite_from_ca_result$mean > anorthite_from_al_result$mean,
  anorthite_from_ca_result$err,
  anorthite_from_al_result$err
)

anorthite_correction <- 0.8
anorthite_final_vol <- anorthite_orig_vol * anorthite_correction
anorthite_final_vol_err <- anorthite_orig_vol_err * anorthite_correction

cat("\nPlagioclase/anorthite calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Original plagioclase: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", anorthite_final_vol, anorthite_final_vol_err))

# 5.8 Calculate amorphous silicate component
crystalline_sum_simple <- ol_final_vol + px_orig_vol + metal_vol_orig + troilite_orig_vol + anorthite_final_vol + mag_primary_vol + schreibersite_vol_percent + apatite_vol_percent
crystalline_sum_err_simple <- sqrt(ol_final_vol_err^2 + px_orig_vol_err^2 + metal_vol_orig_err^2 + 
                                 troilite_orig_vol_err^2 + anorthite_final_vol_err^2 + mag_primary_vol_err^2 + 
                                 schreibersite_vol_percent_err^2 + apatite_vol_percent_err^2)

amorphous_vol <- 100 - crystalline_sum_simple
amorphous_vol_err <- crystalline_sum_err_simple

cat("\nAmorphous silicate calculation:\n")
cat(sprintf("Amorphous silicate: %.1f ± %.1f vol%%\n", amorphous_vol, amorphous_vol_err))

# ===========================================
# 6. Calculate endmember components by weight and mole
# ===========================================

# [Previous endmember calculations remain the same...]
# Calculate molar amounts for olivine, pyroxene, plagioclase as before
ol_mass <- ol_final_vol * d_ol$mean
ol_fo_mass <- ol_mass * olivine_fo_fraction * (forsterite_density/olivine_density)
ol_fa_mass <- ol_mass * olivine_fa_fraction * (fayalite_density/olivine_density)

mol_mass_fo <- 140.69  # g/mol for Mg₂SiO₄
mol_mass_fa <- 203.78  # g/mol for Fe₂SiO₄
ol_fo_moles <- ol_fo_mass / mol_mass_fo
ol_fa_moles <- ol_fa_mass / mol_mass_fa
ol_total_moles <- ol_fo_moles + ol_fa_moles

ol_fo_mol_percent <- ol_fo_moles / ol_total_moles * 100
ol_fa_mol_percent <- ol_fa_moles / ol_total_moles * 100

# Pyroxene endmembers
px_mass <- px_orig_vol * d_px$mean
px_en_mass <- px_mass * pyroxene_en_fraction * (enstatite_density/pyroxene_density)
px_fs_mass <- px_mass * pyroxene_fs_fraction * (ferrosilite_density/pyroxene_density)

mol_mass_en <- 100.39  # g/mol for MgSiO₃
mol_mass_fs <- 131.93  # g/mol for FeSiO₃
px_en_moles <- px_en_mass / mol_mass_en
px_fs_moles <- px_fs_mass / mol_mass_fs
px_total_moles <- px_en_moles + px_fs_moles

px_en_mol_percent <- px_en_moles / px_total_moles * 100
px_fs_mol_percent <- px_fs_moles / px_total_moles * 100

# Plagioclase endmembers
pl_mass <- anorthite_final_vol * d_anorthite$mean
pl_an_mass <- pl_mass * plagioclase_an_fraction * (anorthite_density/plagioclase_density)
pl_ab_mass <- pl_mass * plagioclase_ab_fraction * (albite_density/plagioclase_density)

mol_mass_an <- 278.21  # g/mol for CaAl₂Si₂O₈
mol_mass_ab <- 262.22  # g/mol for NaAlSi₃O₈
pl_an_moles <- pl_an_mass / mol_mass_an
pl_ab_moles <- pl_ab_mass / mol_mass_ab
pl_total_moles <- pl_an_moles + pl_ab_moles

pl_an_mol_percent <- pl_an_moles / pl_total_moles * 100
pl_ab_mol_percent <- pl_ab_moles / pl_total_moles * 100

# Metal composition
metal_fe_wt_percent <- 93.0
metal_ni_wt_percent <- 7.0

# Schreibersite composition (Fe,Ni)₃P
# Typical composition is ~85% Fe, ~7% Ni, ~15% P (by weight)
schreibersite_fe_wt_percent <- 78.0
schreibersite_ni_wt_percent <- 7.6
schreibersite_p_wt_percent <- 15.4

# Amorphous silicate composition
amorphous_mgsi_ratio <- 1.1
amorphous_fesi_ratio <- 0.4
amorphous_alsi_ratio <- 0.08
amorphous_casi_ratio <- 0.06
amorphous_nasi_ratio <- 0.05

# ===========================================
# 7. Generate final results table with P minerals included
# ===========================================

primordial_mineralogy <- data.frame(
  mineral = c("Olivine", "Low-Ca Pyroxene", "Fe,Ni metal", "Schreibersite",
              "Troilite", "Plagioclase", "Apatite", "Primary magnetite", "Amorphous silicate"),
  vol_percent = c(ol_final_vol, px_orig_vol, metal_vol_orig, schreibersite_vol_percent,
                 troilite_orig_vol, anorthite_final_vol, apatite_vol_percent, mag_primary_vol, amorphous_vol),
  vol_error = c(ol_final_vol_err, px_orig_vol_err, metal_vol_orig_err, schreibersite_vol_percent_err,
               troilite_orig_vol_err, anorthite_final_vol_err, apatite_vol_percent_err, mag_primary_vol_err, amorphous_vol_err),
  vol_range = c(
    paste(round(ol_final_vol - ol_final_vol_err, 1), "-", round(ol_final_vol + ol_final_vol_err, 1)),
    paste(round(px_orig_vol - px_orig_vol_err, 1), "-", round(px_orig_vol + px_orig_vol_err, 1)),
    paste(round(metal_vol_orig - metal_vol_orig_err, 1), "-", round(metal_vol_orig + metal_vol_orig_err, 1)),
    paste(round(schreibersite_vol_percent - schreibersite_vol_percent_err, 3), "-", round(schreibersite_vol_percent + schreibersite_vol_percent_err, 3)),
    paste(round(troilite_orig_vol - troilite_orig_vol_err, 1), "-", round(troilite_orig_vol + troilite_orig_vol_err, 1)),
    paste(round(anorthite_final_vol - anorthite_final_vol_err, 1), "-", round(anorthite_final_vol + anorthite_final_vol_err, 1)),
    paste(round(apatite_vol_percent - apatite_vol_percent_err, 3), "-", round(apatite_vol_percent + apatite_vol_percent_err, 3)),
    paste(round(mag_primary_vol - mag_primary_vol_err, 1), "-", round(mag_primary_vol + mag_primary_vol_err, 1)),
    paste(round(amorphous_vol - amorphous_vol_err, 1), "-", round(amorphous_vol + amorphous_vol_err, 1))
  ),
  density = c(olivine_density, pyroxene_density, metal_density, schreibersite_density,
             troilite_density, plagioclase_density, apatite_density, magnetite_density, amorphous_density),
  composition = c(
    sprintf("Fo₉₀Fa₁₀ (%.1f mol%% Mg₂SiO₄, %.1f mol%% Fe₂SiO₄)", ol_fo_mol_percent, ol_fa_mol_percent),
    sprintf("En₈₅Fs₁₅ (%.1f mol%% MgSiO₃, %.1f mol%% FeSiO₃)", px_en_mol_percent, px_fs_mol_percent),
    sprintf("Fe₉₃Ni₇ (%.1f wt%% Fe, %.1f wt%% Ni)", metal_fe_wt_percent, metal_ni_wt_percent),
    sprintf("(Fe,Ni)₃P (%.1f wt%% Fe, %.1f wt%% Ni, %.1f wt%% P)", schreibersite_fe_wt_percent, schreibersite_ni_wt_percent, schreibersite_p_wt_percent),
    "FeS (pure)",
    sprintf("An₈₀Ab₂₀ (%.1f mol%% CaAl₂Si₂O₈, %.1f mol%% NaAlSi₃O₈)", pl_an_mol_percent, pl_ab_mol_percent),
    "Ca₅(PO₄)₃(OH,F,Cl)",
    "Fe₃O₄ (pure)",
    sprintf("GEMS-like (Mg/Si=%.1f, Fe/Si=%.1f, Al/Si=%.2f)", amorphous_mgsi_ratio, amorphous_fesi_ratio, amorphous_alsi_ratio)
  )
)

# Calculate mass percentages
primordial_mineralogy$mass_percent <- primordial_mineralogy$vol_percent * primordial_mineralogy$density
primordial_mineralogy$mass_percent <- primordial_mineralogy$mass_percent / sum(primordial_mineralogy$mass_percent) * 100

# Print final table
cat("\n========== RECONSTRUCTED PRIMORDIAL CI CHONDRITE MINERALOGY (WITH PHOSPHORUS) ==========\n")
print(primordial_mineralogy[, c("mineral", "vol_percent", "vol_error", "vol_range", "mass_percent", "density", "composition")])
cat("======================================================================================\n")

# ===========================================
# 8. Phosphorus mass balance verification
# ===========================================

# Calculate total P content from reconstructed mineralogy
total_p_from_schreibersite <- (schreibersite_vol_percent * schreibersite_density * schreibersite_p_wt_percent / 100) / average_ci_density * 100
total_p_from_apatite <- (apatite_vol_percent * apatite_density * p_in_apatite) / average_ci_density * 100
total_p_calculated <- total_p_from_schreibersite + total_p_from_apatite

cat("\n========== PHOSPHORUS MASS BALANCE VERIFICATION ==========\n")
cat(sprintf("Expected bulk P content: %.3f wt%%\n", bulk_p_content_wt_percent))
cat(sprintf("P from schreibersite: %.3f wt%%\n", total_p_from_schreibersite))
cat(sprintf("P from apatite: %.3f wt%%\n", total_p_from_apatite))
cat(sprintf("Total calculated P: %.3f wt%%\n", total_p_calculated))
cat(sprintf("Difference: %.3f wt%% (%.1f%% relative error)\n", 
            total_p_calculated - bulk_p_content_wt_percent, 
            abs(total_p_calculated - bulk_p_content_wt_percent)/bulk_p_content_wt_percent * 100))
cat("=========================================================\n")

# ===========================================
# 9. Generate detailed endmember breakdown with P minerals
# ===========================================

endmember_breakdown <- data.frame(
  component = c(
    "Forsterite (Mg₂SiO₄)", 
    "Fayalite (Fe₂SiO₄)", 
    "Enstatite (MgSiO₃)", 
    "Ferrosilite (FeSiO₃)", 
    "Kamacite (Fe,Ni metal)", 
    "Schreibersite ((Fe,Ni)₃P)",
    "Troilite (FeS)", 
    "Anorthite (CaAl₂Si₂O₈)", 
    "Albite (NaAlSi₃O₈)", 
    "Apatite (Ca₅(PO₄)₃(OH,F,Cl))",
    "Primary Magnetite (Fe₃O₄)",
    "Amorphous silicate"
  ),
  vol_percent = c(
    ol_final_vol * olivine_fo_fraction, 
    ol_final_vol * olivine_fa_fraction,
    px_orig_vol * pyroxene_en_fraction,
    px_orig_vol * pyroxene_fs_fraction,
    metal_vol_orig,
    schreibersite_vol_percent,
    troilite_orig_vol,
    anorthite_final_vol * plagioclase_an_fraction,
    anorthite_final_vol * plagioclase_ab_fraction,
    apatite_vol_percent,
    mag_primary_vol,
    amorphous_vol
  ),
  density = c(
    forsterite_density,
    fayalite_density,
    enstatite_density,
    ferrosilite_density,
    kamacite_density,
    schreibersite_density,
    troilite_density,
    anorthite_density,
    albite_density,
    apatite_density,
    magnetite_density,
    amorphous_density
  ),
  formula = c(
    "Mg₂SiO₄",
    "Fe₂SiO₄",
    "MgSiO₃",
    "FeSiO₃",
    "Fe₉₃Ni₇",
    "(Fe,Ni)₃P",
    "FeS",
    "CaAl₂Si₂O₈",
    "NaAlSi₃O₈",
    "Ca₅(PO₄)₃(OH,F,Cl)",
    "Fe₃O₄",
    "Variable (GEMS-like)"
  )
)

# Calculate mass percentages for each endmember
endmember_breakdown$mass <- endmember_breakdown$vol_percent * endmember_breakdown$density
endmember_breakdown$mass_percent <- endmember_breakdown$mass / sum(endmember_breakdown$mass) * 100

cat("\n========== DETAILED ENDMEMBER BREAKDOWN (WITH PHOSPHORUS) ==========\n")
print(endmember_breakdown[, c("component", "vol_percent", "mass_percent", "density", "formula")])
cat("====================================================================\n")

# ===========================================
# 10. Visualize results
# ===========================================

# Create bar plot with error bars (excluding very small phases for clarity)
major_phases <- primordial_mineralogy[primordial_mineralogy$vol_percent > 0.1, ]

ggplot(major_phases, aes(x = reorder(mineral, vol_percent), y = vol_percent)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = vol_percent - vol_error, ymax = vol_percent + vol_error), width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Reconstructed Primordial CI Chondrite Mineralogy",
    subtitle = "Volume percentages with uncertainties (phases >0.1 vol%)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Volume %"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Create pie chart showing all endmembers
endmember_breakdown$component <- factor(endmember_breakdown$component, 
                                      levels = endmember_breakdown$component[order(endmember_breakdown$mass_percent, decreasing = TRUE)])

# Combine small phases for cleaner visualization
endmember_vis <- endmember_breakdown
small_phases <- endmember_vis$mass_percent < 1
if(sum(small_phases) > 0) {
  other_mass <- sum(endmember_vis$mass_percent[small_phases])
  endmember_vis <- endmember_vis[!small_phases, ]
  endmember_vis <- rbind(endmember_vis, 
                        data.frame(component = "Other minor phases", 
                                  vol_percent = NA, density = NA, formula = "Various",
                                  mass = NA, mass_percent = other_mass))
}

ggplot(endmember_vis, aes(x = "", y = mass_percent, fill = component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Primordial CI Chondrite Mineral Endmember Distribution",
    subtitle = "Mass percentages (minor phases <1% combined)",
    fill = "Mineral Component"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
# Solving for IOM molecular composition factors
# Target formula: C60.611H45.639O9.941N3.284S1.154
# Components: x*C128H68O7 + y*C5H5N + z*S + m*O

library(MASS)  # For ginv() function if needed

# Define the target elemental composition
target <- c(C = 60.611, H = 45.639, O = 9.941, N = 3.284, S = 1.154)

# Define the coefficient matrix A
# Columns represent: x (i.e. KerogenC128 = C128H68O7), y (i.e. pyridine = C5H5N), z (i.e. S), m (i.e. O).
# Rows represent: C, H, O, N, S
A <- matrix(c(
  128, 5, 0, 0,  # Carbon coefficients
  68,  5, 0, 0,  # Hydrogen coefficients
  7,   0, 0, 1,  # Oxygen coefficients
  0,   1, 0, 0,  # Nitrogen coefficients
  0,   0, 1, 0   # Sulfur coefficients
), nrow = 5, byrow = TRUE)

# Target vector b
b <- as.vector(target)

# Method 1: Least squares solution using QR decomposition
solution_ls <- qr.solve(A, b)
names(solution_ls) <- c("x", "y", "z", "m")

# Method 2: Using pseudoinverse (Moore-Penrose)
solution_pinv <- ginv(A) %*% b
names(solution_pinv) <- c("x", "y", "z", "m")

# Print results
cat("=== LEAST SQUARES SOLUTION ===\n")
cat("Coefficients:\n")
print(solution_ls)

# Verify the solution
reconstructed <- A %*% solution_ls
residuals <- b - reconstructed

cat("\n=== VERIFICATION ===\n")
verification_df <- data.frame(
  Element = c("C", "H", "O", "N", "S"),
  Target = b,
  Reconstructed = as.vector(reconstructed),
  Residual = as.vector(residuals),
  Relative_Error = abs(residuals/b) * 100
)
print(verification_df)

# Calculate total error
total_error <- sqrt(sum(residuals^2))
cat("\nTotal RMSE:", total_error, "\n")

# Alternative: Constrained optimization for non-negative solutions
# If you need non-negative coefficients
library(quadprog)

# Set up for quadratic programming (minimize ||Ax - b||^2)
Dmat <- t(A) %*% A
dvec <- t(A) %*% b

# Constraints: all coefficients >= 0
Amat <- diag(4)
bvec <- rep(0, 4)

# Solve with non-negativity constraints
solution_constrained <- solve.QP(Dmat, dvec, Amat, bvec)$solution
names(solution_constrained) <- c("x", "y", "z", "m")

cat("\n=== NON-NEGATIVE CONSTRAINED SOLUTION ===\n")
print(solution_constrained)

# Verify constrained solution
reconstructed_const <- A %*% solution_constrained
residuals_const <- b - reconstructed_const

verification_const_df <- data.frame(
  Element = c("C", "H", "O", "N", "S"),
  Target = b,
  Reconstructed = as.vector(reconstructed_const),
  Residual = as.vector(residuals_const)
)
print(verification_const_df)

# Function to check solution with custom coefficients
check_composition <- function(x, y, z, m) {
  result <- c(
    C = 128*x + 5*y,
    H = 68*x + 5*y,
    O = 7*x + m,
    N = y,
    S = z
  )
  
  comparison <- data.frame(
    Element = names(target),
    Target = target,
    Calculated = result,
    Difference = target - result
  )
  
  return(comparison)
}

# Example usage of the checking function
cat("\n=== CHECKING UNCONSTRAINED SOLUTION ===\n")
print(check_composition(solution_ls[1], solution_ls[2], solution_ls[3], solution_ls[4]))

# Plotting the results (optional)
if (require(ggplot2)) {
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
  
  # Prepare data for plotting
  plot_data <- verification_df
  plot_data$Element <- factor(plot_data$Element, levels = c("C", "H", "O", "N", "S"))
  
  plot_data_long <- pivot_longer(plot_data[,1:3], 
                                  cols = c("Target", "Reconstructed"),
                                  names_to = "Type", 
                                  values_to = "Value")
  
  # Create comparison plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data_long, aes(x = Element, y = Value, fill = Type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    labs(title = "Target vs Reconstructed Elemental Composition",
         y = "Number of atoms",
         x = "Element") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Target" = "steelblue", "Reconstructed" = "coral"))
  
  print(p)
}
```
